answer: Each identity claims one river reach and yarrow bank, locks 75 credits, and files an echo log with ping, return time, and serial. An auditor recomputes river depth from sound speed and return time and burns the bond on a mismatch over 3 percent, reused serial, or duplicated echo time. First filing costs 36 credits; the kth fake pays 36+5(k-1), so the 1000th pays 5031 and 1000 fakes pay 2,533,500 plus 75,000 locked. A rented-sounder ring fails because one sounder cannot yield distinct serials and echo times. An honest identity pays 36 once and recovers its bond after audit.
